# Physio Dynamics — Physiotherapy & Sports Rehabilitation Centre

> Physio Dynamics is Wayanad's leading physiotherapy and sports rehabilitation clinic, located in Panamaram, Kerala, India. Founded in August 2024 by BPT-qualified physiotherapist Sandra Thomas, we provide evidence-based, personalised physiotherapy across Wayanad including Panamaram, Mananthavady, Kalpetta, and Sulthan Bathery.

## Services Offered in Wayanad

- Orthopedic Physiotherapy in Wayanad — treatment for bones, joints, muscles, post-surgical rehab, back pain, neck pain, arthritis
- Neurological Physiotherapy in Wayanad — stroke rehabilitation, Parkinson's disease, spinal cord injuries, MS, mobility restoration
- Sports Physiotherapy in Wayanad — ACL rehab, sports injury treatment, performance enhancement, return-to-sport programs
- Pediatric Physiotherapy in Wayanad — developmental delays, cerebral palsy, muscular dystrophy, play-based therapy for children
- Chest Physiotherapy in Wayanad — COPD, asthma, bronchitis, post-COVID respiratory rehabilitation, pulmonary care
- Home Care Physiotherapy in Wayanad — mobile physiotherapy for elderly, post-surgical, and mobility-limited patients across Wayanad

## About the Founder

Sandra Thomas is a BPT-qualified physiotherapist and the founder of Physio Dynamics. She specialises in orthopedic, sports, and neurological rehabilitation and is committed to delivering evidence-based, patient-centred care to the community of Wayanad.
